mapper.sql: id, customer_name, customer_id_card, name, cert_no, report_no, query_time, report_time, status, retry_count, error_msg, app_no, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_pbccrc_report (customer_id_card, customer_name, app_no, status, retry_count, heartbeat_time, content_hash, create_time, creator_id) VALUES (#{customerIdCard}, #{customerName}, #{appNo}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{heartbeatTime}, #{contentHash}, #{createTime}, #{creatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_pbccrc_report SET status = 'PARSING', heartbeat_time = NOW(), error_msg = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE t_pbccrc_report SET heartbeat_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PARSING'

UPDATE t_pbccrc_report SET name = #{name}, cert_type = #{certType}, cert_no = #{certNo}, query_time = #{queryTime}, report_time = #{reportTime}, marital_status = #{maritalStatus}, report_no = #{reportNo}, description = #{description}, credit_record_description = #{creditRecordDescription}, query_record_description = #{queryRecordDescription}, common_record_description = #{commonRecordDescription}, common_record_detail = #{commonRecordDetail}, credit_record_summary = #{creditRecordSummary}, credit_card_total = #{creditCardTotal}, credit_card_active = #{creditCardActive}, credit_card_overdue = #{creditCardOverdue}, credit_card_serious_overdue = #{creditCardSeriousOverdue}, credit_card_guarantee = #{creditCardGuarantee}, housing_loan_total = #{housingLoanTotal}, housing_loan_active = #{housingLoanActive}, housing_loan_overdue = #{housingLoanOverdue}, housing_loan_serious_overdue = #{housingLoanSeriousOverdue}, housing_loan_guarantee = #{housingLoanGuarantee}, other_loan_total = #{otherLoanTotal}, other_loan_active = #{otherLoanActive}, other_loan_overdue = #{otherLoanOverdue}, other_loan_serious_overdue = #{otherLoanSeriousOverdue}, other_loan_guarantee = #{otherLoanGuarantee}, asset_total = #{assetTotal}, repayment_total = #{repaymentTotal}, status = 'SUCCESS', error_msg = #{errorMsg}, heartbeat_time = NOW(), modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PARSING'
UPDATE t_pbccrc_report SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = #{errorMsg}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PARSING'
UPDATE t_pbccrc_report SET status = 'PENDING', heartbeat_time = NOW(), modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PARSING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE t_pbccrc_report SET status = 'PENDING', heartbeat_time = NOW(), modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_pbccrc_report WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PARSING') AND heartbeat_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
SELECT id FROM t_pbccrc_report WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetry}
SELECT id, customer_name, customer_id_card, report_no, query_time FROM t_pbccrc_report WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count >= #{maxRetry} ORDER BY modify_time DESC
